_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-13. CardID = 17600 + idx; 360 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 60). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, hence card_count 31 and card_ids [360, 17629] in the catalog. His deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the turtles' and the other heroes': only deck.identity (data/tts/chupacabra.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Every card's band reads CHUPACABRA (no sidekicks). Titles, types, values, boosts, copies and texts of all 11 titles agree with unmatched-memory (whose casing is 'The more they struggle'; the card prints Title Case, kept in `title`, the memory spelling in `memory_title`). Hero card read from the image: CHUPACABRA, MELEE, MOVE 3, special ability THE HUNGER 'After you attack, you may draw a card.'; the START HEALTH digit is half hidden by the icon in the image, unmatched-memory says 14. Schemes print no value: unmatched-memory has 0 for the two schemes, the overlay writes `value: null` (idx 25-29).
